Take a few steps southwest to be back on the first screen, then check the
ground near the left stone pillar to find a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Now make your
way back into the village, and use the Save Point if you wish. Go to the
northwest part of the area and search the somewhat hidden area to the right of
the church to find a [_MANA SEED_]. Head east to the next area, then make your
way all the way to the right; there's a [_TALISMANOFWISOM_] in the northeast
corner near the gate.

Once you have those items, check the door to the house to the southeast, where
a little girl will ask if you're her dad.

——————————————————————————————————————
   [1] No, it's a monster
   [2] I'm a friend of your father.
——————————————————————————————————————

Choose 2 to be let inside, where you'll have some dialogue with Terry's family.
Afterward, you'll regain control outside, and will have to do battle with
monsters randomly, as the fog is red. Head west back to the first area.

  NOTE     Examining the first door to the north here to will give you access
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   to the weapon shop. Again, hold off just a bit until we get that
           Guild Card.

Examine the door to the house in the northwestern corner for a scene, then go
back to the eastern side of town. Check the doors to the houses to the north
for some dialogue, then go back into the southeastern house for a long scene,
where you'll receive the [_EAST GATE KEY_].

Before leaving, check the floor at the bottom-right of the screen near the
barrels and boxes for a [_MOON SWALLOW_], then open a somewhat hidden chest on
the right side of the room for the [_MOON CARD_]. If you like, shop with Nina
for some items, and make sure to stop by the weapons shop to upgrade Alice's
and Zhuzhen's equipment. When you're ready, go to the eastern side of the
village and examine the eastern gate. Unlock it?

——————————————————————————————————————————
   [1] No, I don't want to leave.
   [2] Yes, go through the east forest.
——————————————————————————————————————————

Choose 2 to unlock the gate and proceed. Out here on the World Map, enter the
Blue Castle.
